title: O3K Doctor machine output
description: Stable machine-readable output of `o3k doctor --json`. Read-only by construction; MUST NOT contain secrets (passwords, tokens, private keys, user-data, or unredacted configuration). The schema version is the o3k doctor binary version (workspace version).

version.description: Doctor schema version, equal to the o3k binary (workspace) version.

overall_status.description: healthy = no WARN/FAIL; warning = at least one WARN and no FAIL; unhealthy = at least one FAIL. Exit code 0 only for healthy.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp captured when the run started.

category.description: Human output section: Host / Services / Control plane / Database / Identity / Compute agent / Libvirt/KVM / Networking/DHCP / Cloud/API / Security boundaries / Installed release.

summary.description: Short human explanation of the finding. Never contains secrets.

details.description: Optional detail lines. Never contains secrets.

recommended_actions.description: Safe read-only next diagnostic commands (e.g. `systemctl status o3k-compute`). Present on every FAIL and WARN; never repair/mutating commands.
